cues: mount the gun to the face, not the face to the gun

name: Medicine-Ball Rotational Toss (Shotgun Swing)
description: Rotational power toss mimicking the shotgun swing — transverse-plane explosiveness for clay sports.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, feet shoulder-width. Hold a med ball at waist level. Rotate the trunk and throw the ball hard into the wall across the body. Catch the rebound; repeat.

name: PVC Fly-Casting Endurance
description: Simulated fly-casting with a PVC dowel — builds the specific shoulder endurance and elbow control of long days on the river.
instructions: Hold a PVC dowel like a fly rod. Perform controlled 10-and-2 casting strokes with crisp stops. 30-60 seconds per side. Focus on forearm/wrist-driven motion, not big arm sweeps.
progression: Longer bout or light weight added.

name: CO2 Tolerance Breath-Hold Tables
description: Static breath-hold intervals — trains CO2 tolerance for spearfishing and freediving without an in-water session.
instructions: Seated or supine. Inhale, hold breath for 60 sec. Breathe freely 90 sec. Hold 60 sec, breathe 75 sec. Hold 60 sec, breathe 60 sec. Continue reducing breathe intervals. Stop if anxious.
progression: Longer holds or shorter breathe intervals.

name: Supine Finning Kick Drill
description: Dryland finning drill — hip-flexor and glute endurance for spearfishing and long fin/monofin swims.
instructions: Lie supine on a mat, hands under glutes, legs straight and slightly elevated. Alternate long slow kicks from the hip — like finning with a monofin — for 30-60 seconds.
cues: kick from the hips, not the knees

name: Weighted Vest Step-Up
description: Step-ups with a weighted vest — specific to backcountry hunters and bow hunters managing steep terrain under pack load.
instructions: Wear a weighted vest (15-30 lb). Step up onto a 12-18" box with one foot, stand tall, lower with control. Complete reps on one side before switching.
cues: no pushing off the trailing foot

name: Sandbag Shoulder Carry
description: Heavy sandbag loaded on one shoulder — asymmetric loaded carry mimicking packing out game.
instructions: Hoist a heavy sandbag onto one shoulder. Walk 40-60 ft maintaining tall posture. Switch shoulders at the halfway point or on the next carry.

name: Isometric Bow-Draw in Field Positions
description: Archer draw isometric from kneeling / sitting / canted positions — specific to bow hunting's awkward field postures.
instructions: Using a resistance band at draw weight, assume a field position (kneeling, seated on the ground, leaning into a tree). Draw to anchor and hold 10-15 seconds. Release with control. Rotate positions across sets.

name: Single-Leg Slackline Stance Progression
description: Stance-to-single-leg balance progression on a slackline — the core skill for slacklining and highlining.
instructions: On a rigged slackline (low tension, short span), mount with one foot centered. Find balance; try raising the other foot briefly, then lower. Progress to full single-leg stance and walking.
cues: eyes on a fixed far point
soft knee on the stance leg
progression: Walk the line / turn on the line.

name: Foam-Pad Single-Leg Balance
description: Single-leg stand on a foam pad or Bosu — the baseline progression for slackline prep and ankle-sprain rehab.
instructions: Stand on one foot on a foam pad, balance board, or Bosu. Hold for 30-45 seconds. Progress by closing the eyes, adding head turns, or performing reaching motions with the free leg.
cues: foot spreads wide into the pad
home_variation: Folded pillow or rolled yoga mat.

name: Toe Spread + Foot Doming
description: Intrinsic-foot strength drill — trains the deep foot muscles critical for slacklining, barefoot balance, and foot-arch health.
instructions: Seated or standing, plant the foot flat. Try to spread the toes wide apart without lifting the sole. Then, without curling toes, shorten the foot — doming the arch. Hold 5-8 seconds per position.
cues: arch does the work, not toe curl

name: Towel Scrunch
description: Toe-flexor endurance drill — scrunching a towel under the foot. Key for foot-intrinsic strength in slacklining and barefoot sports.
instructions: Seated, place a small towel on the floor under your foot. Using only the toes, scrunch the towel toward you. 15-25 scrunches per side.
progression: Add resistance by placing a weight on the far end of the towel.

name: Reactive Start Drill
description: Start-on-cue explosive drill — handler-side speed for dog-agility and bikejoring starts.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance. On a partner's or timer's cue, explode into a 10-15 ft sprint or first stride. Reset and repeat. Short, quality reps only.

name: Deceleration Drop-Step
description: Drop-step deceleration to change direction — critical for dog handlers and any reactive-sport athlete.
instructions: Jog 10-15 ft to a cone. At the cone, drop the outside foot back, sink into the hips, and explode in the new direction. Focus on quiet, absorbed steps.
cues: sink the hips on the drop

name: Overhead Sandbag Lockout Carry
description: Heavy sandbag pressed overhead and carried — strongman-style overhead stability under odd-object load.
instructions: Press a sandbag overhead with both hands, arms locked. Walk 30-50 ft maintaining lockout. Drop, rest 2 min, repeat.
cues: arms locked, biceps by the ears
short steps as load fights back
home_variation: Loaded duffel bag or plate overhead.

name: Wall Sit (Ski Tuck)
description: Isometric quad hold in a low tuck position — the single best sliver of ski-specific strength for an off-day.
instructions: Back flat against a wall, feet shoulder-width and out far enough that knees end at 90 degrees. Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor. Hands off thighs. Hold 30-90 seconds. Breathe through the burn.
progression: Single-leg wall sit or weighted vest.

name: Single-Leg Skater Squat
description: Unilateral knee-dominant squat that mimics the edge-by-edge load of carving and telemark transitions.
instructions: Stand on one leg, the other leg trailing behind with the knee just above the floor. Squat by sitting the hips back and bending the standing knee until the trailing knee kisses the floor. Drive up through the mid-foot. Use a light TRX or door frame for balance at first.
home_variation: Bodyweight + TRX or doorway for balance.
regression: Assisted skater squat (light hold on wall / strap).
progression: Weighted skater squat or deficit skater squat.

name: Lateral Box Jump (Over)
description: Frontal-plane plyometric — builds the lateral edge-change power that carving skiing and snowboarding demand.
instructions: Stand to the side of a low box. Jump laterally up and over the box, landing soft on the far side with a quiet athletic stance. Step around (not jump back) to reset. Build from a 12 in box up.
home_variation: Low sturdy box, cone, or step.
progression: Higher box or continuous lateral bounds.

name: Eccentric Step-Down (Ski Descent)
description: Slow eccentric unilateral descent — the single most transfer-friendly drill for ski-specific quad strength.
instructions: Stand on an 8-12 in box on one foot. Slowly lower the opposite heel to tap the floor over 4-5 seconds, then drive back up. Keep hips level and knee tracking over toes.

name: Ski Imitation Bounds
description: Lateral jumping imitation drill used by XC skiers and biathletes — trains double-push stride rhythm.
instructions: Stand in athletic stance. Bound laterally from one foot to the other, pushing off explosively and driving the opposite arm. Land soft and repeat immediately. 20-30 m sets.

name: Double-Pole Ergometer Intervals
description: Nordic-ski ergometer interval — the most direct off-snow trigger of the XC double-pole engine.
instructions: On a ski-erg or cable pulldown. Stand tall, then fold forward at the hips, pressing the handles down past the thighs with straight arms, finishing behind the hips. Stand back up tall and reset. 30-60 sec intervals.
home_variation: Ski-erg, or cable machine with straight-bar attachment.
progression: Longer intervals or max-effort sprint pulls.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobility (Knee-to-Wall)
description: Closed-chain ankle mobility — the range the front foot needs to sit into a telemark lunge or ski boot.
instructions: Stand facing a wall. Place one foot a few inches back with heel planted. Drive the knee forward to the wall without lifting the heel. Work the knee past the toe. 10 reps per side.
progression: Add load (KB held at chest) to deepen ROM.

name: Split-Stance Isometric (Telemark Sit)
description: Isometric split stance — trains the telemark and skimo uphill posture.
instructions: Step into a deep split stance, back knee hovering just above the floor. Hold 30-60 seconds, weight 60% on front leg. Switch sides.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Slam (Ice-Axe Swing)
description: Transverse-plane slam — builds the rotational power needed for ice-climbing axe swings and freestyle ski rotations.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, holding a slam ball. Rotate the torso, loading one hip. Drive the ball down and across to slam at the far ankle. Catch, reset, repeat. Alternate sides.

name: Jump Rope Double-Unders (Ski Foot-Quickness)
description: High-output jump rope work — doubles as ski and skate foot-quickness plus calf/achilles prehab.
instructions: Jump rope with two passes of the rope per jump. Stay on the balls of the feet, small jump, flick with the wrists (no shoulder sweep). 30-60 sec bouts.

name: Prone Snow Angel (Ski Pole Plant)
description: Prone scap and rotator-cuff activation — important for pole plant and ice-axe swing posture.
instructions: Lie face-down, arms out in a T. Sweep hands overhead (Y) and back to hips (I), keeping arms off the floor. Move slowly; squeeze from the mid-back, not the neck.

name: Suitcase Carry (Ski Tour Load)
description: Unilateral loaded carry — anti-lateral-flexion core + grip staple for backcountry touring and pack days.
instructions: Hold a single heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand. Stand tall, shoulders level, chin over sternum. Walk 20-30 m. Switch hands, repeat. Do not let the loaded side sag.
home_variation: Dumbbell, kettlebell, sandbag, or heavy backpack.

name: Farmer Carry Loaded Hike
description: Bilateral loaded carry — bread-and-butter snowshoe, ski tour, and mountaineering prep.
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells / kettlebells at sides (or wear a weighted pack). Walk 30-60 m at a brisk pace. Keep posture tall; breathe through the effort.

name: Pogo Hops (Ski-Specific Ankle Stiffness)
description: Pure ankle-stiffness plyometric — foundation for running, bounding, and ski-boot control.
instructions: Small continuous hops in place, bouncing off the balls of the feet. Keep knees nearly straight — power comes from the calves and Achilles. 20-30 sec sets.

name: Anti-Rotation Pallof Hold
description: Cable / band anti-rotation isometric — braces the core against ski edge forces and snowboard traverse torque.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height. Stand sideways to the anchor, press the handle straight out at sternum, arms locked. Hold 20-30 seconds resisting the pull back to the anchor.

name: Hip Airplane (Ski Carving)
description: Single-leg hip disassociation drill — trains the rotational ankle-hip chain needed for ski and skate carving.
instructions: Balance on one leg with a slight knee bend. Hinge forward at the hip, back leg extending behind. Rotate the pelvis open and closed around the standing hip without losing alignment. 6-8 reps per side.
home_variation: Bodyweight + wall for light touch-balance if needed.
regression: Use a wall for balance assist.
progression: Close eyes or add ankle weight.

name: Box Jump to Stick (Soft Landing)
description: Box jump with an emphasis on landing mechanics — primer for ski-drop absorption and XC/skimo transitions.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box. Load the hips, swing arms, jump to the center of the box and stick the landing soft in an athletic stance. Step (not jump) down. Reset every rep.
progression: Box jump over or single-leg box jump.

name: Slide-Board Skate Shuffle
description: Slide-board lateral pushes — the cleanest dryland replica of the skate-ski and XC skate stride.
instructions: On a slide board, push off one booty and glide to the far bumper, catch with the opposite foot, push back. 30-60 sec sets. Keep hips low, chest over knees.
home_variation: Slide board with booties (or socks on smooth floor).

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Deficit)
description: Unilateral calf raise off a step — essential for ski boot push-off and skimo climbing.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a step, heel hanging below. Slowly lower the heel past the step for 3 seconds, then rise to full plantar flexion. 12-15 reps per side.
home_variation: Stair or low box + wall for balance.

name: Tuck Hold (Skiing-Specific)
description: Low tuck hold in a downhill racer's position — specific ski fitness in one movement.
instructions: Feet hip width, shins pressed forward (as if into ski boots), chest over thighs, forearms on thighs, hips low. Hold 30-60 seconds. Breathe.
cues: forearms on thighs, chest over knees

name: Weighted Pack Hike
description: Loaded hiking with a pack — the single most specific off-day session for any mountaineering or thru-hiking objective.
instructions: Load a pack to 20-40% of bodyweight (start light). Walk uphill or on rolling terrain for 45-90 minutes at conversational effort. Prioritize steady cadence and even breathing over pace.
time_efficient_variation: Treadmill on an incline with a pack.
progression: Heavier load, steeper grade, or longer duration.

name: Uphill Treadmill Ruck
description: Weighted treadmill walk at 10-15% grade — substitute for pack hiking on weather or city days.
instructions: Load a pack to 15-30% bodyweight. Set treadmill to 10-15% grade at a walking pace that lets you complete 30-60 min without running. Arms swing naturally.
progression: Heavier pack, higher grade, or hill intervals.

name: Step-Up with Pack (High Box)
description: High box step-up carrying a pack — translates directly to big uphill steps with a loaded kit.
instructions: Wear a weighted pack. Step up onto a knee-height or slightly higher box with one foot, drive through the heel to stand tall, and lower with control. Alternate sides.

name: Box-Step Downhill Eccentric
description: Slow eccentric step-down with a pack — the underrated prep for brutal long descents.
instructions: Stand on a knee-height box wearing a pack. Slowly lower one foot to the floor over 3-4 seconds, barely touching before stepping back up. Keep hips level.

name: Altitude Breathing Drill (Box Breathing)
description: Box-breath protocol — primary tool for altitude acclimatization and CO2 tolerance.
instructions: Seated or lying. Inhale 4s through the nose. Hold 4s. Exhale 4s through pursed lips. Hold empty 4s. Repeat for 5-10 min. Advance to 5-5-5-5 then 6-6-6-6 as tolerated.
cues: do not force the empty hold

name: CO2 Tolerance Drill (Exhale Hold)
description: Exhale-hold protocol — improves CO2 tolerance, a core altitude-adaptation marker.
instructions: Sit tall. Take 3 normal breaths. On the third exhale, hold empty until the first real urge to breathe. Recover 60s. Repeat 5-8 rounds. Track time and progress weekly.
cues: end on the first real urge

name: Stair Sprint Intervals (Weighted)
description: Weighted stair sprint — aerobic-power driver for technical and expedition mountaineering.
instructions: Wear a light pack (5-15 kg). Sprint up a long staircase at a pace you can sustain for 30-60s, walk down to recover. 6-10 intervals. Drive arms, maintain upright posture.
home_variation: Stadium, building stairwell, or long outdoor stair.

name: Alpine Start Warm-Up Flow
description: Full-body dynamic warm-up designed for cold-morning mountaineering starts.
instructions: Cycle: 20 arm circles forward/back, 10 leg swings per side, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 walking lunges per side, 10 mountain climbers, 10 inchworms. Repeat 2 rounds. 5-8 minutes.
progression: Add plyos or a weight vest.

name: Loaded Reverse Lunge (Pack)
description: Weighted reverse lunge wearing a pack — ass-kicker for hiking-specific leg strength.
instructions: Wear a pack or hold dumbbells. Step back into a lunge, back knee just short of the floor. Drive through the front heel to return. Complete reps; switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift (Backpack)
description: Unilateral hinge holding a weighted pack low — hamstring and balance work that mirrors the terrain step-over.
instructions: Hold a pack in both hands or wear it. Balance on one leg, hinge at the hip, extending the back leg as a counterweight. Return by squeezing the planted glute. 8 per side.
progression: Heavier load or deeper hinge ROM.

name: Overhead Carry (Light Pack Overhead)
description: Loaded overhead carry — shoulder stability + postural core for via-ferrata, aid, and alpine climbing via-scrambles.
instructions: Press a light kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with one arm locked out. Walk 15-25 m, keeping ribs over pelvis and shoulder packed. Switch arms.
regression: Bottom-up KB carry with shorter distance.

name: Iso Hike Hold (Trekking Pole Sim)
description: Low split-stance isometric hold with poles — recreates the loaded pause on steep hiking.
instructions: Assume a split stance. Hold light dumbbells (as trekking-pole proxies) tip-down. Hold low, back-knee just off floor, 20-30 seconds. Switch legs.
progression: Longer hold or heavier hand load.

name: Downhill Walk (Sub-Max Eccentric)
description: Steady downhill walk on rolling trail — targets quad eccentric capacity for thru-hiking descents.
instructions: On a gentle downhill grade (5-15%), walk 30-45 minutes at an easy pace. Land softly, knee-soft. Use poles if available.

name: Hypoxic Walk (Nasal Breathing Only)
description: Nasal-breathing-only walk — builds CO2 tolerance and simulates some altitude demand at sea level.
instructions: Walk at moderate pace, breathing only through the nose. If you must mouth-breathe, slow down. 20-45 minutes. Add hills as tolerance grows.

name: Turkish Get-Up (Light Load)
description: Ground-to-standing progression under load — shoulder stability + full-body control for alpine scrambling recovery-if-slip scenarios.
instructions: Hold a light KB or water bottle overhead. Lie on your back. Roll to elbow, to hand, sweep leg, lunge, stand. Reverse sequence. 3 per side.
cues: each position is its own hold

name: Stair Walk-Down (Pole-Assisted)
description: Pole-assisted stair descent — low-demand technique drill for trekking-pole coordination.
instructions: Use trekking poles or broomsticks. Walk down a flight of stairs using poles like on a downhill, planting pole before weight shifts. Slow and rhythmic.

name: Calf Raise Endurance (Bilateral High-Rep)
description: High-rep bilateral calf raise — soleus endurance for long uphill days.
instructions: Stand tall, raise up to toes, lower under control. 25-50 reps per set. Focus on full plantar flexion.

name: Uphill Hill Repeats (Running or Hiking)
description: Repeat efforts up a hill — aerobic-power primer for mountaineering and fastpacking.
instructions: Find a hill that takes 45-90 seconds to ascend at a hard effort. Go up at ~90% effort. Walk down to recover. 6-10 reps.
cues: last rep as strong as the first
progression: More reps, longer hill, or with pack.

name: Dead Hang with Pack
description: Dead hang wearing a light pack — grip and shoulder endurance for alpine/via-ferrata objectives.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar wearing a light pack. Full hang, shoulders engaged. Hold 15-45s. Build duration before adding load.

name: Mountaineer Pace Clock (Deliberate-Breath Walk)
description: Rest-step + breath-cadence walk drill — the skill that lets you go all day at altitude without blowing up.
instructions: Walk slowly. Lock the trailing leg briefly to let it rest (rest-step). Inhale-exhale cycle on every step pair. Keep it slow; let it become automatic.

name: Ice Tool Swing (Rotational Med-Ball)
description: Rotational med-ball swing simulating ice-tool stick — the closest dryland mimic of the axe swing.
instructions: Hold a light med-ball (6-10 lb) at chest. Rotate the torso up-and-across, swinging the ball overhead and down with the rotating elbow finishing high. Catch, reset, repeat. Switch sides.
cues: swing from the core, not the arm
progression: Heavier med ball or standing-to-kneel sweep.

name: Ice Tool Dead Hang (Tool-Grip Sim)
description: Dead hang on an ice tool or grip-sim attachment — the direct transfer to hooked/ice grip endurance.
instructions: Hang from ice tools mounted to a pull-up bar, or from a grip-bar simulating a D-shaped ice-tool handle. 15-45s. Shoulders engaged.
home_variation: Ice tools + beefy pull-up bar; or thick-bar grip.
regression: Hang from towel draped over bar.
progression: Single-tool hang or weighted pack hang.

name: Via Ferrata Cable-Pull Simulation
description: Vertical band pull + hand-over-hand simulation — mimics the via-ferrata cable clip-and-pull rhythm.
instructions: Anchor a heavy band high. Stand below. Pull the band toward you hand-over-hand in a controlled rhythm, alternating hands just like clipping past anchors. 30-45s sets.

name: Aid-Climbing Aider Step-Up Sim
description: High-step unilateral with a hanging loop — trains the deep flexed-hip step into an aider.
instructions: Hang a single loop of webbing from a pull-up bar at waist height. Step into the loop with one foot, weight transfer, stand tall. Step down under control. 8-10 per side.
cues: weight transfers fully onto the aider
progression: Weighted vest or heavier aider loop.

name: Rappel Brake-Hand Isometric
description: Heavy band pull-down held static with one hand — builds the brake-hand strength for long rappels.
instructions: Anchor a heavy band overhead. Grip with one hand. Pull down to the hip and hold 15-30s, arm bent just past 90. Keep scapula packed. Switch sides.

name: Deep-Water Fall Entry Drill
description: Controlled entry from height into deep water — safe fall practice specific to deep-water soloing.
instructions: From a pool edge or platform 3-5 m high, jump feet-first in a pencil (legs together, arms crossed over chest) into deep water. Exit, reset, repeat. 5-10 entries.
home_variation: Deep pool or natural water pool >3 m depth.
progression: Higher entry or simulate tool-holding fall.

name: Comp-Climbing Parkour Dyno
description: Powerful horizontal dyno from one handhold to another across a gap — bread-and-butter for boulder/comp style.
instructions: Set up between two sturdy holds (campus rungs, rings, or a comp-wall setup) 3-5 ft apart. From a hang, explosively swing and launch sideways to the other hold. Match, then reset.
home_variation: Comp wall or two sturdy parallel holds.
progression: Larger gap or horizontal dyno on worse holds.

name: Scrambling Down-Climb Drill
description: Slow, deliberate down-climbing on easy terrain — trains the reversed-movement brain needed for class 3-4 exits.
instructions: On a V0/V1 problem or easy traverse, climb up, then slowly reverse each move exactly, facing into the rock. Maintain three points of contact.
home_variation: Boulder wall or easy outdoor slab.

name: Multi-Pitch Belay-Stance Isometric
description: Long half-squat iso holding a loaded rope — belayer endurance for long pitches.
instructions: Stand in a half squat against a wall. Hold a knotted rope or band with both hands, as if belaying. Hold 1-2 min. Keep glutes engaged and breath steady.

name: Alpine Crampon Box-Step
description: High step-up in stiff boots simulating a front-point kick-in — transfers to alpine and ice approach style.
instructions: Wear stiff boots (or heavy shoes). Step onto a knee-height box by driving through the ball of the foot (as if front-pointing). Stand tall, step down slowly. Alternate feet.
cues: drive through the ball of the foot

name: Swim Bench Paddle Intervals
description: Swim-specific ergometer or cable pull intervals — anaerobic transfer to freestyle/paddle pull.
instructions: On a paddle-erg or cable crossover, perform a swim-stroke pull at hard effort for 30s. 60s recovery. 6-10 rounds.

name: Breath-Hold Squats (Dry CO2)
description: Air-squat bout with repeated breath holds — CO2 tolerance for freediving and water polo chase sets.
instructions: Inhale, hold, squat 10-15 air squats. Exhale, recover. Repeat 6-8 rounds. Build squat count slowly; never push to near-blackout.
progression: More squats per hold or static apnea between.

name: Dryland Flutter Kick (Weighted Ankles)
description: Weighted dryland flutter kick — hip-flexor and core endurance for any swim kick base.
instructions: Lie supine, small ankle weights. Press lower back into floor, legs straight. Perform small, fast flutters from the hips for 30-60s. Core braced.
progression: Heavier ankle weights or longer sets.

name: Eggbeater Simulation (Banded)
description: Seated alternating hip-rotation against bands — simulates the eggbeater kick used in water polo and artistic swimming.
instructions: Sit on a bench, thighs parallel. Loop a band around each ankle anchored outward. Alternate circles at each hip (one in, one out) with controlled rhythm for 30-60s.
regression: Slow alternating hip circles, no band.

name: Single-Arm Push-Up on Stability Ball
description: Unstable unilateral pressing — mimics paddle-and-stand board-sport transitions.
instructions: In push-up stance with one hand on a stability ball, other on the floor. Perform a push-up while stabilizing the ball. 6-8 per side.
regression: Push-up with hand on bench (no ball).
progression: Two hands on ball or archer push-up.

name: Pop-Up Plank to Standing (Surf Transition)
description: Surf-style pop-up drill — trains the plank-to-standing transition for surfing and wakeboarding.
instructions: Lie prone, hands planted chest-high. In one motion, press up and swing feet under the body to land in a surf stance. Stand tall, reset. 8-10 reps.
regression: Slow step-up pop instead of explosive.
progression: Pop-up onto a Bosu for instability.

name: Indo Board Balance Hold
description: Balance board hold — foundation for surf, wake, kite, wing, hydrofoil stance.
instructions: Stand on an indo board or balance board with feet shoulder-width. Find balance. Hold 30-60 sec. Progress to light squat and small rotations.
progression: Single-leg indo hold or dynamic squats.

name: Bosu Squat to Rotation
description: Squat-and-twist on an unstable platform — trains the rotational carve of surf and snowboard.
instructions: Stand on the flat side of a Bosu or soft side. Squat to parallel, then rotate the torso to face one side and return. Alternate. 8 per side.
progression: Add a medicine ball or heavier rotation.

name: Harness Hike Simulation (Isometric)
description: Loaded hip-hike hold simulating a windsurf/kite harness lean — postural-endurance staple.
instructions: Anchor a heavy band at hip height. Clip harness or loop to waist. Lean back, shoulders, hips, heels in one line, hands on the line for grip. Hold 30-45 seconds.
home_variation: Heavy band + harness or sturdy strap.
regression: Hold a pull-up bar in a hinged lean.
progression: Longer hold or load the line.

name: Paddle-Stroke Cable Row (Unilateral)
description: Cable single-arm paddle-stroke row — direct carryover to canoeing, SUP, rafting.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine, low attachment. Hinge slightly. Pull one arm back through a paddle-stroke arc, rotating the torso. Return, then repeat with other arm.
cues: other hand holds the dry shaft
progression: Heavier cable or split-stance paddle row.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press
description: Half-kneeling unilateral landmine press — shoulder-save pressing pattern for paddlers and surfers.
instructions: Half-kneel sideways to a landmine. Hold the bar with one hand at shoulder. Press the bar up and slightly across. Return under control.

name: Unloaded Turkish Sit-Up
description: Half of the Turkish get-up — bulletproof rotator cuff and core for paddle and wave sports.
instructions: Lie supine, one arm vertical (empty hand or light load). Same-side knee bent. Roll up to sit balanced on the opposite elbow. Lower with control. 5 per side.
progression: Add light KB / continue to half-kneel.

name: Prone Swim Pull with Mini-Band
description: Banded prone swim-pull drill — freestyle-specific lat recruitment.
instructions: Lie face-down on a bench, upper body off the edge. Hold a looped mini-band between hands overhead. Pull the band out and down to the hips, then return. 12-15 reps.
progression: Heavier band or weighted dumbbell flye.

name: Medicine-Ball Rotation Slam (Spike Sim)
description: Rotational med-ball slam — simulates the water-polo shot and spearfishing aim-rotation.
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, med-ball at chest. Rotate to one side loading the hip. Rotate back and slam the ball in front at the same angle. Reset. Alternate sides.

name: Dryland Finning Drill
description: Dryland fin kicking drill — freediving and spearfishing hip-driven long fin pattern.
instructions: Lie prone on a low bench or foam pad with legs hanging off. Perform long, straight-leg flutter kicks originating at the hips. 30-60 sec.

name: Static Apnea Walk
description: Walking breath-hold — practical transfer for spearfishing, freediving, water polo chase.
instructions: Inhale fully. Hold breath. Walk at an easy pace until the first strong urge to breathe. Recover 60s. 5-8 rounds. Never push to blackout. Progress time slowly.
regression: Seated breath hold instead of walking.

name: Kneeling Banded Chop (Water Polo Shot Sim)
description: High-to-low banded chop from a half-kneeling stance — simulates the torso-driven polo shot.
instructions: Anchor band high. Half-kneel sideways. Grip with both hands, pull the band across and down diagonally, finishing at the far hip. Return under control.

name: Single-Leg Balance (Eyes Closed)
description: Proprioceptive single-leg stand with eyes closed — foundation for every board sport.
instructions: Stand on one leg, soft knee. Close eyes. Maintain balance for 20-45 sec. Switch sides.

name: Weighted Carry in Surf-Stance
description: Loaded walk in a surf-style staggered stance — asymmetric core + lower body for surf/wake.
instructions: Stand in a surf-stance (feet staggered sideways to travel direction). Hold a heavy dumbbell in the back hand. Walk slow, controlled, 20-30 m. Switch stance.
progression: Heavier load or add uneven surface.

name: Open-Water Swim Aerobic Set
description: Threshold-pace continuous swim — the aerobic engine for open-water and triathlon swim.
instructions: Warm up 200m. Swim continuously at threshold effort (slightly faster than conversational) for 20-40 min. Alternate breathing sides every 3-5 strokes. Cool down 100m.
home_variation: Pool, open water, or tow buoy in open water.
regression: Shorter duration or rest 15s every 5 min.
progression: Longer duration or add threshold intervals.

name: Board Pop-Up on Foam
description: Board pop-up on foam pad — progression drill for stand-up paddling, surf, wake.
instructions: Lie prone on a soft foam pad. Push up explosively to a stable stance as if on a board. Hold 2-3s. Lower and reset. 8-10 reps.
progression: Pop-up on a Bosu for instability.

name: Crab-Walk with Paddle Arms
description: Reverse-facing crawl pattern — posterior shoulder, glute, and core for rafting and paddling.
instructions: Sit with knees bent, hands behind. Lift hips. Crawl backward, driving arms and feet in a reciprocating pattern. 10-20 m.
progression: Add a slow sideways crab pattern.

name: Supine Snow Angel (Shoulder Mobility)
description: Supine shoulder mobility sweeps — opens the shoulder for paddling, swimming, and surf paddle-out.
instructions: Lie supine, arms at sides. Slowly sweep arms overhead along the floor and back. Keep low back pressed into the floor. 8-10 reps.
cues: arms stay on the floor as long as possible

name: Bilateral Rowing Ergometer Aerobic
description: Steady aerobic rowing-ergometer session — transfers to any paddle sport and swim cross-training.
instructions: Rowing erg. 20-40 minutes at conversational pace (can speak in full sentences). Smooth drive, rhythmic recovery. Stroke rate 18-22.

name: Swim-Run Transition Brick
description: Short swim followed immediately by a short run — trains swimrun transitions.
instructions: Swim 200-400 m (pool or open water). Exit water, pull on shoes, run 1-2 km. Repeat 3-5 brick cycles.
home_variation: Pool + running path access, or open water + trail.
progression: Longer bricks or hilly run leg.

name: Cyclocross Shoulder Carry Drill
description: Shoulder-carry run with a bike (or a surrogate load) — the defining cyclocross skill.
instructions: Pick up a bike (or 15-30 lb sandbag on your shoulder). Run 20-30 m with it, jog around a cone, run back. 4-6 reps. Focus on smooth mount/dismount.
regression: Walk pace shoulder carry without running.

name: BMX Sprint Stand Starts
description: Short maximal standing sprints on a bike — BMX gate-style explosive torque output.
instructions: From a standing stop, crank 8-12 hard strokes out of the saddle. Accelerate, then sit and roll. Rest fully. 6-8 reps.
progression: Start on a slight uphill for more torque.

name: Indoor Cycling Zone-2 Ride
description: Steady aerobic trainer ride at conversational effort — aerobic base for every cycling discipline.
instructions: Warm up 10 min. Ride at conversational pace (can speak in full sentences) for 45-90 min. Keep cadence 85-100 rpm.
progression: Longer session or add tempo blocks.

name: MTB Ready-Position Isometric
description: Attack / ready-position hold — the low-stance foundation of mountain biking technical handling.
instructions: Stand in a bike-attack position: feet hip-width, knees bent, hips back, elbows out, eyes up. Hold 30-60s. Add small rocks side to side.
progression: Hold on an indo board or slight incline.

name: Single-Leg Pedal Drill (Trainer)
description: Unilateral pedaling on trainer — trains pedal smoothness and deficit leg.
instructions: On a trainer, unclip one foot. Pedal smoothly with the other leg for 30s. Switch. Focus on eliminating dead spots through the stroke.

name: Rolling Hill Tempo (Bike)
description: Continuous rolling-hills ride at tempo — specific aerobic-power for gravel/road/gravel-racing.
instructions: Ride a rolling-hill loop for 45-90 min, holding tempo effort (80-85% threshold). Sit for flats, stand for steep rollers. Smooth transitions.

name: Bike Handling Slalom Drill
description: Tight slalom through cones — handling skill and core for MTB, cyclocross, BMX.
instructions: Set cones 3-5 m apart. Slalom through them at moderate pace, then return faster. 4-6 sets. Work on looking ahead, not down.
progression: Tighter cones or on a rough surface.

name: Sled Push (Hill Simulation)
description: Sled push walk — loaded eccentric-quad-free effort that transfers to cycling climbs.
instructions: Push a loaded sled 20-40 m at steady pace. Keep hips low, arms extended, steady breath. Walk back. 4-6 reps.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge March
description: Glute-and-core march from a single-leg bridge — unilateral cycling-specific glute activation.
instructions: Lie supine, one foot planted, the other knee lifted. Drive hips up. Alternate knee drives to chest without dropping hips. 8 per side.
progression: Weighted march or add band resistance.

name: Hill Sprint on Bike
description: Short uphill sprints on bike — VO2 and neuromuscular power.
instructions: Find a 30-60s hill. Sprint up at near-max effort. Roll down to recover. 4-8 reps.

name: Neck-Extensor Isometric (Low Bar Position)
description: Cervical extensor iso — prehab for the neck strain specific to long drop-bar sessions.
instructions: Face down on a bench, head unsupported, chin neutral. Hold the head in line with the spine for 30-45s. Repeat 3 times.
home_variation: Bench or edge of a bed.
progression: Add a small weight plate on head.

name: Plank with Alt Shoulder Tap
description: Plank with alternating shoulder taps — anti-rotation core for drop-bar riding and handlebar control.
instructions: From a push-up plank, slowly tap one shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking the hips. Alternate. 10 per side.
progression: Deficit plank or add leg lift.

name: High-Cadence Spin Intervals
description: Short intervals at very high cadence — neuromuscular smoothness transfer to road/indoor cycling.
instructions: On trainer or flat road. 30s at 110-120 rpm (moderate resistance), 60s easy spin. 6-10 reps.

name: Dog-Pull Harness Walk (Bikejoring Prep)
description: Harness-assisted walk with a dog — gait and cue foundation for bikejoring and canicross.
instructions: With the dog in a pulling harness, leash attached to a hip belt. Walk then jog while the dog pulls ahead. 10-20 min.
cues: cues first: easy, whoa, gee, haw
let the dog lead but not drag
progression: Run pace or add bike contact (bikejor).

name: Seated Box Trainer Tempo (E-Bike Sim)
description: Steady moderate-resistance trainer session — base fitness for e-bike riders managing assist use.
instructions: Ride trainer at moderate resistance. 30-60 min. Alternate 10-min seated with 5-min standing. Keep effort near the assist-handover line.
progression: Longer session or add standing efforts.

name: Track Sprint Build 60s
description: Progressive 60 m sprint — primary masters-sprint neuromuscular session.
instructions: Build from 50% to ~90% effort across 60 m. Walk back recovery. 6-10 reps.

name: Technical Trail Run (Short)
description: Short rock-and-root trail run at steady effort — specific skill + aerobic work for trail/fell/mountain running.
instructions: On technical singletrack, run 20-45 min at steady conversational pace. Look 3-5 m ahead. React, don't brake.

name: Hill Repeats (Uphill Running)
description: Short uphill running repeats — aerobic-power and leg strength for any running niche.
instructions: Find a 45-90s hill. Run up at hard effort, walk/jog down. 6-10 reps.

name: A-Skip Drill
description: Running mechanics drill — knee-drive and triple-extension pattern.
instructions: Skip forward, driving one knee to hip height, same-side arm driving back, opposite arm forward. Alternate. 20-30 m sets.
cues: drive knee to hip, foot to glute

name: B-Skip Drill
description: A-skip with a paw-back — trains the active foot plant.
instructions: Skip forward driving the knee up, then kick the foot out and pull it back to plant under the hip. Alternate. 20-30 m sets.

name: Long-Run Aerobic Base
description: Conversational long run — the cornerstone of any aerobic-sport base.
instructions: Warm up 10 min jog. Run continuously at conversational pace for 60-150 min. Walk breaks allowed.

name: Sandbag Over Obstacle (OCR)
description: Sandbag-carry to hop-over drill — OCR-specific loaded-traverse practice.
instructions: Shoulder a 30-50 lb sandbag. Walk 30 m. Lift over a knee-height obstacle, step-over, continue. Alternate shoulders. 4-6 loops.

name: Monkey-Bar Traverse
description: Hand-over-hand monkey-bar traverse — OCR grip and shoulder endurance.
instructions: Traverse monkey bars hand over hand, alternating grips if possible. 3-5 full traverses.
home_variation: Monkey bars or pull-up bar array.

name: Map Running Short-Course
description: Short map-based run — orienteering and rogaine skill under light fatigue.
instructions: Get a local park map + compass. Run a 30-60 min course visiting control points. Alternate route-choice pairs.

name: Short Hill Bounding
description: Exaggerated bounding uphill — running-specific power and stride length.
instructions: Bound uphill exaggerating each stride, arms driving. 10-15 bounds per rep. 4-6 reps. Walk down.

name: Stroller / Dog-Line Running Drill
description: Run drill with a pulling leash — canicross gait coordination.
instructions: Attach a dog in a pulling harness to a bungee leash on a running belt. Run 15-30 min maintaining coordinated pace and cues.
cues: let the line stay taut, not yanking

name: Wall-Climb Practice (OCR)
description: Timed wall-climb rehearsal — OCR event-specific skill.
instructions: Find a 5-7 ft wall or sturdy box. Run in and climb up with a single leap-and-pull. Drop off the far side. 6-8 reps.
home_variation: OCR wall, high fence, or sturdy box.

name: Brick Run-After-Bike
description: Short run immediately after a bike ride — triathlon transition specificity.
instructions: Ride bike 30-60 min at aerobic pace. Immediately change into running gear and run 15-30 min. Focus on leg turnover the first 5 min.
cues: prep gear in a T1 layout

name: Tempo Run (Threshold)
description: Threshold-effort tempo run — classic engine builder for all distance running.
instructions: Warm up 15 min. Run 20-40 min at threshold pace (hard but can speak in 2-3 word phrases). Cool down 10 min.
progression: Longer or broken intervals at threshold pace.

name: Calf Drop Eccentric
description: Weighted eccentric calf drop — achilles-prevention prehab for runners.
instructions: Stand on a step holding a dumbbell. Rise to toes on both feet, shift to one, lower slowly (3-4s) on one leg. Use both to rise back up.

name: Race-Pace Strides
description: Short race-pace strides — speed maintenance for all running disciplines.
instructions: After easy warm-up, run 6-10 strides of 80-100 m at race pace with full recovery between. Keep form relaxed.

name: Adventure-Race Load Carry
description: Loaded carry mixing sandbag, buckets, and odd-object style — AR-specific utility strength.
instructions: Shoulder a sandbag 20 m, switch shoulder. Pick up a 50 lb bucket in each hand and carry 20 m. Repeat 3-5 rounds.

name: Progression Run
description: Running session that builds pace throughout — ideal for multi-sport and distance-race prep.
instructions: Run 45-75 min. First third easy, second third moderate, final third tempo. Don't blow up in the last 10 min.

name: Weighted Vest Stair Repeats
description: Weighted-vest stair-repeat session — fell-running and OCR ascent specificity.
instructions: Wear a 10-20 lb vest. Run or power-hike a long staircase up. Walk down. 8-12 reps.
home_variation: Stadium or building stairs + weighted vest.
progression: Heavier vest or longer stair flight.

name: Barefoot Grass Strides
description: Short barefoot strides on grass — foot-intrinsic strength and form reset.
instructions: On a flat grass field, do 4-6 barefoot strides of 50 m at easy pace. Focus on soft mid-foot landing.
cues: stop if feeling any foot pain
progression: More strides or hill barefoot strides.

name: Stance Transition Drill (Deep Stances)
description: Chain of traditional stances (horse, bow, cat, forward) with controlled transitions — core skill for kung-fu and karate.
instructions: Move through a sequence: horse stance to bow stance to forward stance to cat stance, each held 3-5s. Travel 10 m per set.

name: Lunge with Sword Guard Hold
description: Deep lunge with both arms held in a saber-style guard — fencing/HEMA/kendo/iaido posture endurance.
instructions: Assume a deep en-garde lunge position. Extend one arm in front (blade proxy), other hand near hip. Hold 30-45s. Switch sides.
progression: Longer holds or add light DB for sword arm.

name: Shadow Strike Flow (Unloaded)
description: Continuous shadow-boxing-style strike flow with footwork — cardiovascular + combat rhythm for any striking art.
instructions: Move and strike through 2-3 min rounds: punches, hand traps, kicks, evasions. Keep it fluid. 3-5 rounds with 60 sec rest.
progression: Longer rounds or add partner call-outs.

name: Capoeira Ginga Drill
description: The fundamental capoeira back-and-forth rocking step — foundation for every movement.
instructions: Alternate stepping back with each leg, hands in guard moving opposite to the rear leg. Maintain a low, fluid rhythm for 2-3 min.
progression: Add au kick, queda de rins, or combo.

name: Sword Draw Iso Hold (Iaido)
description: Half-drawn sword iso hold — builds the forearm and shoulder endurance for iaido drawing (nukitsuke).
instructions: In seiza or standing, hold a bokken or PVC with one hand, handle at hip, tip-forward, half-drawn. Hold 30-45s with other hand on sheath proxy.
progression: Longer hold or add draw/sheathe reps.

name: Roll & Break-Fall Drill
description: Controlled forward and backward rolls and break-falls — foundation for aikido, sambo, judo adjunct.
instructions: From a crouch, perform a forward shoulder roll. Stand. Repeat. Add back break-falls and side rolls. 5-8 reps each direction.
progression: Weighted vest or combat roll chain.

name: Wrist & Joint-Lock Partner Flow
description: Slow partnered wrist/joint flow — aikido wrist and small-joint mobilization.
instructions: With a partner, flow through wrist locks (kote-gaeshi, nikajo) at 30% resistance, focusing on kuzushi (off-balance). 5-10 min.

name: Fencing Footwork Ladder
description: Advance / retreat / lunge pattern through a ladder — fencing footwork precision.
instructions: Lay an agility ladder on the floor. Advance, advance, retreat, lunge out of the last rung. Build to reverse patterns. 3-5 rounds.
progression: Add an imaginary opponent and reaction cues.

name: Kendo Shinai Swing (Suburi)
description: Large overhead shinai swing from shoulder to target — core kendo conditioning.
instructions: Grip a shinai or bokken. From a rear-up position, cut down to eye-level target (men) with a snap. Return overhead. 30-50 reps.

name: HEMA Longsword Zornhau Drill
description: HEMA-style oblique cut (zornhau) — builds the core rotation and grip-transition for longsword arts.
instructions: From vom Tag (shoulder-held) guard, deliver an oblique diagonal cut down-and-across. Chain 10-15 alternating sides. Focus on edge alignment.

name: Krav-Maga Combative 3-Strike Burst
description: Rapid 3-strike burst under stress — Krav Maga tactical conditioning.
instructions: From neutral, on a timer cue, deliver 3 strikes: palm-hammer, knee, elbow — as fast as possible. Reset to neutral. 10 bursts.

name: Sambo Takedown Rehearsal (Single-Leg)
description: Single-leg takedown rehearsal against a heavy bag — sambo and wrestling shot specificity.
instructions: From a combat stance, shoot to a single-leg on a heavy bag: drop step, knee tap, lift. 8-10 shots per side. Slow, precise reps first.

name: Taekwondo Round Kick Drill
description: Repeated round-house kick drill — taekwondo-specific hip rotation and kick speed.
instructions: Standing by a kicking bag, throw 10 round kicks per side, alternating target heights (low, mid, high). Reset stance after each.
regression: Slow kick rehearsals at lower height.
progression: Double kick or rapid-fire round kicks.

name: Sword-Draw Shoulder Mobility
description: Shoulder external rotation + overhead reach drill with a dowel — iaido / kendo cut prep.
instructions: Hold a dowel behind the back with both hands. Press the dowel up and away from the body, opening the shoulders. 10-15 slow reps.

name: Partner Kiai Breathing Drill
description: Short powerful kiai exhale on strike cadence — trains combat-breath and core brace.
instructions: Facing a partner or target, exhale sharply with a kiai on each strike. 10 bursts, 5 s rest between. Focus on core brace simultaneous with exhale.

name: Jumping Switch Lunge (TKD Power)
description: Scissor jump switching lunge feet mid-air — taekwondo and capoeira leg-speed staple.
instructions: From a split-stance, jump and switch feet mid-air. Land softly. 20 total jumps (10 per lead leg).
progression: Jumping switch lunge with light dumbbells.

name: Cable Chop (Samurai Cut)
description: Cable high-to-low chop in a deep stance — diagonal-cutting power for HEMA, kendo, iaido.
instructions: Set cable high. Stand sideways, grip handle with both hands. Rotate through a diagonal chop down and across to the far hip. Reset.

name: Low-Profile Guard Conditioning
description: Bodyweight defensive low-guard hold + small evasion motions — tactical drill for krav, kung fu.
instructions: Assume a deep low guard (elbows tight, knees bent). Hold 30s doing small slips and weight shifts. Rest 30s. 5-6 rounds.

name: Double-Foot Stomp Reset
description: Fast double-foot stomp + combat reset — neural primer for fencing/TKD/BJJ start positions.
instructions: Stand in stance. Stomp both feet hard in place, simultaneously reset hands to guard. 10 reps. Rest 30s. 3 rounds.
progression: Add a lead-leg attack after stomp.

name: Paper-Cut Test Drill (Iaido Edge Alignment)
description: Slow-motion cutting drill against a suspended paper strip — edge-alignment skill.
instructions: Hang a paper strip at shoulder height. With bokken or dowel, practice slow-motion cuts that clip the paper without tearing it. 10-15 cuts.
progression: Faster cutting speed or blind-folded draws.

name: Dinghy Hiking Iso Hold
description: Straight-leg hike-out isometric — sailing-specific quad and core endurance.
instructions: Sit on a sturdy bench or edge. Anchor feet under straps or a heavy object. Lean back with straight legs, back roughly parallel to the floor. Hold 30-60s.
home_variation: Bench + heavy anchor or hiking bench.
progression: Longer hold or add a tether pull.

name: Tiller-Extension Rotational Row
description: Seated rotational cable row — sailors' steering-arm endurance.
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench with a cable anchored forward. Holding a handle, row the cable back while rotating the torso. Return under control. 8-10 per side.
progression: Heavier cable or add pause at end range.

name: Trapeze Plank Hold
description: Plank with feet elevated and straight-arm grip — catamaran/skiff trapeze-style iso.
instructions: Plank with feet on a low bench, arms straight, hands on the floor, body in line. Hold 30-45s.
progression: Feet higher or add arm reach.

name: Tack-Transition Footwork Drill
description: Side-to-side quick footwork drill — sailing tack maneuver practice on dryland.
instructions: Set two marks 3 m apart. Side-shuffle + duck (simulating the boom) + continue to the other mark. Reverse. 30-45s sets.
progression: Add a partner call-out for tack vs jibe.

name: Neutral-Spine Seated Forward Hold
description: Neutral-spine forward lean hold with weighted pack — hang-glide/paraglide harness posture.
instructions: Wear a weighted pack on the chest (10-20 lb). Sit with legs extended. Lean forward maintaining neutral spine, arms extended forward as if on harness bar. Hold 45-60s.
home_variation: Weighted pack or backpack with water bottles.

name: Neck Extensor Endurance (Prone Hold)
description: Prone neck-extensor endurance hold — hang-gliding and racing-sail postural prehab.
instructions: Prone on a mat, hands under chin. Lift head so the cervical spine is neutral. Hold 30-60s without jutting the chin. 3 sets.
progression: Add light weight plate on back of head.

name: Forward-Leaning Run-Launch Drill
description: Dryland forward-leaning run drill simulating a paraglide launch.
instructions: Hold a light pole or yoke with arms outstretched overhead simulating risers. Lean forward aggressively and run 10-20 m as if taking off. Reset. 5-8 launches.

name: Reverse-Launch Wing Handling Drill
description: Reverse-facing handling pattern simulating a kiting paraglide wing.
instructions: Face backward holding risers (or two handles on a band anchored to a wall). Lean back, pull risers, turn, step forward, and sprint. 5-8 reps.
home_variation: Bands or paraglide wing + open space.

name: Land-Sailing Hiking Squat Iso
description: Seated hiking iso specific to land-sailing boat stance.
instructions: Sit in a deep wide-stance squat with heels pressed down. Grip imaginary sheet lines. Hold 30-60 s.
progression: Longer hold or add band pull.

name: Keelboat Grinder Arm Cranks
description: Arm-cranking ergometer or upper-body ergometer intervals — keelboat grinder specificity.
instructions: On an upper-body ergometer or arm-crank, perform 30-60s hard bouts alternating arms or two-arm. Rest 60s. 6-10 reps.
home_variation: Upper-body erg (or heavy band cable crank).

name: Shoulder-Blade Endurance (Y-T-W on Bench)
description: Prone Y-T-W mid-back endurance — classic sailing and gliding prehab.
instructions: Prone on a bench with light dumbbells. Perform 8 Ys (arms at 120 deg), 8 Ts (90 deg), 8 Ws (elbows at sides). Thumbs up.
progression: Heavier DB or paused at top.

name: Glider Harness Sit Iso
description: Supine-ish iso holding a seated-harness position — hang-glider / paraglider specific.
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back about 45 degrees supported by forearms. Hold that angle with legs straight forward at hip height. Hold 30-60s.
progression: Add overhead reach or weighted arms.

name: Seated Loaded Reach
description: Seated KB/DB-loaded forward reach — sailing postural endurance.
instructions: Seated on a bench with a dumbbell. Extend both arms forward holding the weight at shoulder height. Hold 20-30s. Breathe. Lower.
progression: Heavier weight or hold with single arm.

name: Crew-Jump Box Drill
description: Single-leg box drill simulating boat-to-boat jumps — keelboat/dinghy crew agility.
instructions: Stand next to a low box. Jump up onto it with one leg, land, step off. Alternate sides. 6-8 per side.
progression: Higher box or continuous box taps.

name: Balance-Board Swivel Squat
description: Squat on balance board — vestibular and ankle training for land-sailing, sailing, gliding.
instructions: Stand on a balance board. Squat to a shallow depth while stabilizing. 6-8 reps. Work up to deeper squats.

name: Adductor Ball Squeeze (Rider Seat)
description: Seated adductor squeeze with a ball — seat and inner-thigh strength for riders.
instructions: Sit upright on a chair with a small ball between the knees. Squeeze hard for 5s, relax 2s. 10 reps.
progression: Longer hold or add KB goblet.

name: Posting Trot Squat Intervals
description: Rhythmic shallow squat simulating a posting trot — cardiovascular + rider-specific leg.
instructions: Shallow squat up/down at a steady tempo matching a posting trot (about 60 bpm). 2-min bouts with 1-min rest. 4-6 rounds.
progression: Heavier tempo or add a KB goblet.

name: Rider Core Plank with Reach
description: Plank with alternating arm reach — core stability for rein handling under motion.
instructions: From a push-up plank, slowly reach one arm forward, return, switch. 8 per side. Keep hips square and level.
progression: Longer holds each reach or deficit plank.

name: Mounted-Trail Breath Drill
description: Slow cyclical breath drill — mindful calm-state practice for trail riders and endurance rides.
instructions: Inhale 4s, exhale 6s with relaxed shoulders. 5-10 min. Perform seated or on horseback at halt.

name: Sparring-Ready Rider Mobility Flow
description: Short full-body mobility flow before riding — hips, thoracic, ankle.
instructions: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 thoracic rotations per side, 5 ankle circles per side, 5 cat-cow. 3 rounds.

name: Bow-Draw Isometric (Banded)
description: Held band-draw isometric — archery and bow-hunting shoulder-back endurance.
instructions: Anchor a band to a post at bow height. Take a full draw and hold for 20-30s. Release slowly. Switch sides every set.

name: Shotgun Mount Iso
description: Held mount of a shotgun in the shoulder pocket — endurance for clay shooters.
instructions: Mount an unloaded shotgun (or dowel/PVC as a proxy) to the shoulder pocket. Hold the firing position for 30-60s. Switch cheeks after a set.
home_variation: Unloaded shotgun or PVC pipe with taped weight.
progression: Longer hold or add small pan while holding.

name: Pistol Grip Strength Hold
description: Isometric crush-grip hold — builds finger-strength for archery draw and firearm stability.
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand, arm extended, at hip. Squeeze hard for 20-30s. Switch sides.

name: Casting Practice Drill (Fly Fishing)
description: Deliberate fly-casting drill in dryland with a rod or dowel — tempo and shoulder coordination.
instructions: With a fly rod (no line) or dowel, perform 30-50 casts focusing on 10-2 o'clock stroke, stopping crisply. Alternate arms.

name: Loaded Pack Crouch Walk
description: Low-crouch stalking walk with a pack — foundation for hunting approaches.
instructions: Wear a 15-30 lb pack. Walk in a low crouched-knees stance (half-squat) for 30-60 m. Steady, quiet steps.
progression: Heavier pack or hill crouch walk.

name: Shoulder External Rotation Band
description: Banded external rotation — bow and shotgun shooter rotator-cuff endurance.
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height. Grip with the far hand, elbow tucked at 90. Rotate the forearm outward. 12-15 reps per side.

name: Stillness + Aim Drill
description: Static aim-hold over a target — breath + postural control for archery and clay shooting.
instructions: Hold the bow (or a shotgun) in full-aim position over a dry target. Hold for 10-15s without shake. 6-8 reps with rest.
progression: Longer holds or add heart-rate variability monitoring.

name: Spearfishing Finning Intervals
description: Interval finning drill — spearfishing-specific kick endurance.
instructions: In a pool with long fins, fin 50m at steady pace. Rest 30s. Repeat 8-12 times.
progression: Longer laps or weighted belt finning.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Throw (Golf-Specific)
description: Explosive rotational med-ball throw — golf and disc-golf swing power.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a med ball at chest. Rotate and throw the ball hard into the wall. Catch, reset, repeat.
progression: Heavier ball or add a hop-step.

name: Hip-Rotation Open/Close Mobility
description: Quadruped or standing hip-rotation drill — unlocking golf and disc-golf hip turns.
instructions: Quadruped: alternate internal and external rotation of one hip 8-10 reps per side. Slow and controlled.
progression: Add load with a band or ankle weight.

name: T-Spine Rotation with Reach
description: Side-lying thoracic rotation with arm reach — bread-and-butter for golfers' thoracic mobility.
instructions: Side-lying, knees at 90. Open the top arm across the body, following with eyes. Hold 3s. Return. 8 per side.
progression: Add a yoga block / slow return phase.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing (Golf Power)
description: Unilateral KB swing — asymmetric hinge power for golf and golf-fitness.
instructions: Hike a KB one-handed between legs, snap the hips to drive it chest-high. Catch in the same hand. 10 per side.
progression: Heavier KB or switch-hand swings mid-set.

name: Mini-Band Lateral Shuffle (Disc Golf)
description: Mini-band lateral shuffle — hip abductor activation for disc-golf/topgolf reach & rotate.
instructions: Mini-band above the knees. Assume half-squat. Shuffle laterally 10 steps, return. Repeat 3-5 rounds.

name: Senior-Friendly Golf Mobility Warmup
description: Short mobility warm-up for 55+ golfers — hip, thoracic, shoulder prep with no load.
instructions: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 arm circles forward / back, 5 torso rotations, 5 bodyweight squats. 2 rounds.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop (Golf)
description: Cable chop from half-kneeling — trains rotational power without locking the hips.
instructions: Half-kneel sideways to a cable stack. Pull a high-attachment handle down and across with both hands to the far hip. 8-10 per side.
progression: Heavier cable or add standing rotation.

name: Topgolf Swing Tempo Drill
description: Slow-motion swing-tempo drill — for topgolf/range practice players without breaking form.
instructions: Take a normal golf stance. Perform slow-motion swings (3 sec backswing, 3 sec downswing). 10 slow swings, 5 normal. Repeat.

name: Fishing Pack Carry
description: Loaded carry with a fishing pack — strength + trail specific for fly fishing approaches.
instructions: Wear a 10-20 lb pack. Walk 400-800 m over uneven terrain. Keep posture tall. Repeat on terrain variability.

name: Deep Forward Lunge Rotation
description: Deep lunge with torso rotation — common for bow hunting stalks and golf end-of-swing follow-through.
instructions: Step into a deep forward lunge, then rotate the torso over the front knee. Hold 2-3s. Alternate. 6-8 per side.
progression: Add a med-ball reach to deepen rotation.

name: Static Balance with Rifle/Bow Mount
description: Static single-leg balance while holding a rifle/bow mount — real-hunt prep.
instructions: Stand on one leg in a soft shoe. Mount a rifle or bow (or PVC). Hold 30-45s. Switch.

name: Standing Oblique Crunch with Club
description: Standing oblique crunch holding a weighted club — sport-specific oblique work.
instructions: Stand tall holding a clubbell or light dumbbell overhead. Side-bend slowly toward the weighted side. 8-10 per side.

name: Clay-Pigeon Follow-Through Drill
description: Slow-motion horizontal tracking drill — trap/skeet/sporting-clays follow-through.
instructions: Mount an unloaded shotgun (or dowel). Track a horizontal line across the wall smoothly, pulling the trigger-finger midway, follow-through to the far side. 5 per side.

name: Equestrian Core Rotation Sit-Up
description: Sit-up with rotational reach — torso stability for posting, 2-point, jumping.
instructions: Lie supine with knees bent. Sit up, reaching one arm across the opposite knee. Return. Alternate. 8 per side.

name: Pommel Horse Position Iso
description: Seated pommel-horse position iso — polo player's and dressage rider's seat endurance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball. Lift both feet off the floor and hold legs parallel to the floor for 20-45s. Maintain neutral spine.
progression: Extend one leg, then both, then hold.

name: Low-Row Isometric (Archery Posture)
description: Rowed isometric with light band — prehab for archery / bow hunting upper-back endurance.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height. Grip and row elbows past the ribs. Hold 20-30s. Keep mid-back squeezed.
progression: Longer hold or unilateral row iso.

name: Walk-and-Aim Drill
description: Walk forward while maintaining steady aim — rifle/shotgun/bow simulation in motion.
instructions: Walk slowly and steadily while holding an aim line on a far target. 15-30 m sets. Quiet footfalls, steady breath.

name: Sun Salutation Flow (Yoga Warmup)
description: Surya Namaskar chain — warm-up and mobility flow core to any yoga practice.
instructions: Cycle: mountain pose, forward fold, half-lift, low push-up, upward dog, downward dog, step forward, fold, return. 5-8 full rounds.

name: Tai Chi Silk Reeling Circle
description: Fundamental silk-reeling circular arm pattern — tai chi coordination and structural warmup.
instructions: Stand in a wide stance. Trace a continuous figure-8 in front of the body with both arms, alternating hands, at 60-80 circles per minute. 3-5 min.
progression: Add leg crossovers or larger arcs.

name: Dance-Fitness Cardio Block
description: Zumba-style dance cardio block — aerobic + coordination for dance-fitness and swing-dance prep.
instructions: Follow a 4-song cardio block of mixed steps (side tap, grapevine, mambo). Keep moving through low-intensity recovery steps.

name: Swing Rock-Step Drill
description: Foundational swing-dance rock-step pattern — rhythmic footwork drill.
instructions: Stand. Rock step back onto the right foot, shift weight back to left, tap-step tap-step in the rhythm of swing timing. 2-3 min continuous.

name: Skate Edge Lateral Pushes
description: Dryland lateral push drill — skating-wheeled and roller-derby specific stride.
instructions: In skate stance, push off one booty to slide laterally onto the other foot. Alternate. 30-60s sets. Work on full weight transfer.
home_variation: Socks on smooth floor or slide board.
progression: Slide board or load for harder push.

name: Slackline Static Single-Leg
description: Single-leg balance hold on a slackline — highline/slackline balance skill.
instructions: Stand on a low slackline with one foot. Hold 15-30 sec. Use eyes on a fixed point. Switch sides.

name: Table-Tennis Footwork Shadow Drill
description: Side-shuffle + swing-shadow — table-tennis/beach-tennis/racquetball footwork.
instructions: Side-shuffle left, shadow backhand. Side-shuffle right, shadow forehand. 30-45s sets, 4 rounds.
cues: weight on the balls of the feet
progression: Add a partner call-out for backhand vs forehand.

name: Dodgeball Duck-and-Throw Drill
description: Duck-to-throw transition — dodgeball/kickball quick evasion + release.
instructions: Stand with a light ball. Duck quickly, rise, and throw hard toward a target. Reset. 5-10 reps.

name: Team-Handball Jump-and-Throw
description: Jumping ball throw — team-handball specific offensive motion.
instructions: Running approach, one-foot take-off, throw a med ball (3-5 kg) hard into a wall. Catch rebound or reset. 4-6 reps per side.
progression: Heavier ball or multiple consecutive throws.

name: Olympic Snatch-Balance (Empty Bar)
description: Snatch-balance drill with empty bar — Olympic-weightlifting technique progression.
instructions: Grip bar wide overhead behind neck. Press bar up as you drop into an overhead squat. Drive back to standing. 5-6 reps.

name: Kettlebell Snatch Sets
description: High-rep kettlebell snatch sets — kettlebell-sport specific endurance.
instructions: Snatch a moderate KB (16-24 kg) 10-15 reps per side, alternating each set. 5-10 sets total. Rest as needed.
progression: Heavier KB or EMOM snatch sets.

name: Sandbag Stone-to-Shoulder
description: Sandbag / stone lifted from floor to shoulder — strongman / highland games specific.
instructions: Lift a heavy sandbag from the floor. Drag to chest, transition to one shoulder. Walk 5-10m. Drop. 4-6 reps alternating shoulders.

name: Pole-Hold Inversion Iso
description: Inverted pole hold — pole-fitness specific strength iso.
instructions: Climb a pole into an inverted position. Hold inverted with core braced and grip secure for 10-20 sec. Lower controlled.
progression: Longer holds or complex pose combinations.

name: Pilates Hundred (Classic)
description: Pilates Hundred — classic core endurance exercise.
instructions: Lie supine, head and shoulders lifted, legs at 45 deg, arms hovering. Pump arms small and fast, breathing 5-in/5-out. 100 pumps total.

name: Bodybuilder Lateral Raise (Myo-Reps)
description: Dumbbell lateral raise with myo-reps — bodybuilding shoulder size-building protocol.
instructions: Lateral raise 15-20 reps, rest 15 sec. Repeat 3-5 mini-sets of 5-8 reps with same rest. Strict form.

name: Highland Games Caber Sim (Sandbag Flip)
description: Long sandbag lift and flip — simulates the caber toss of highland games.
instructions: Stand a long sandbag upright. Hoist it onto the shoulder, then with a run-up, release the bag forward into a vertical flip. 3-5 reps.
cues: release at the top of the arc

name: Slack-Line Walk Across
description: Full walk across a slackline — slacklining skill progression.
instructions: On a short low slackline, walk from one anchor to the other. Start with a spotter. 3-5 full crossings.

name: Sandboard Squat-Pop Sim
description: Dryland squat-pop drill simulating sandboard / mountain-board descent stance.
instructions: Assume a wide athletic stance. Squat deep, then pop up and land in the same stance. 8-10 reps. Small rotation on landing.

name: Geocaching Pack Walk
description: Light pack walk on uneven terrain — foundational fitness for geocaching and misc outdoor travel.
instructions: With a 5-15 lb pack, walk 45-90 min on varied terrain. Steady pace, hydrate, observe surroundings.

name: Dog-Agility Call Drill (Handler)
description: Handler agility drill — short sprint to marker + call to dog — dog-agility handler fitness.
instructions: Set three markers in a triangle 10 m apart. Sprint to one, call dog, cross to another. 4-6 circuits.
regression: Walk the triangle for slower practice.
progression: Add multiple dogs or random cue order.

name: Calisthenics Skill Flow (Crow/L-Sit/Plank)
description: Short skill-flow: plank → crow → L-sit → plank — bodyweight progression for misc rec/fitness.
instructions: Start in plank 10s. Move to crow pose 5-10s. L-sit 5-10s. Return to plank. 3-5 rounds.

name: Hydrofoil Pump-Balance Drill
description: Balance + micro-squat drill simulating hydrofoil pumping cadence.
instructions: Stand on a balance board. Small continuous knee-bend pumps (5-10 deg) without losing balance. 30-60 sec.

name: Racquetball Quick-Reaction Drill
description: Reaction drop-catch drill — racquetball/squash quick-hand prep.
instructions: Partner drops a ball. React, catch before second bounce. 20-30 reps, alternating sides.

name: Beach-Tennis Lateral Lunge Drill
description: Low lateral lunges + racquet swings — beach-tennis and paddle footwork.
instructions: Step into a deep lateral lunge, swing racquet across. Reset, other side. 10 per side.
progression: Faster tempo or with partner feeds.

name: Orienteer Compass-and-Map Jog
description: Map-reading jog at easy aerobic pace — integrates navigation skill with steady cardio.
instructions: Jog 20-45 min at conversational pace while navigating a small park using a map and compass. Relocate every 200 m.

name: BMX Pump-Track Squat Pulse
description: Rhythmic partial-squat pulse mimicking the up/down pumping cadence of a BMX pump track.
instructions: Stand in quarter-squat stance, feet wide. Rhythmically pump the hips and arms down-up-down-up at 80-100 bpm for 30-45s, as if loading/unloading a pump-track roller. Arms drive with the pump.
progression: Add a light med-ball for pump resistance.

name: BMX Standing Start Sprint Drill
description: Explosive standing-start sprint specific to BMX gate starts and track launches.
instructions: From a split-stance standing position, explode into 10-15 m sprint as if clearing a BMX gate. Walk back, full recovery. 4-6 reps.
progression: Weighted sled start or paired with plyo bounds.

name: BMX Whip Rotational Core
description: Standing cable chop simulating the whip-rotation used on BMX dirt and park.
instructions: Cable or band anchored chest-high. Stand side-on. Drive the cable from high-side to low-opposite-knee in a whip rotation. 8-10 per side.

name: E-Bike Sustained Cadence Ride
description: Sustained Zone-2 ride with a target cadence of 80-90 rpm on an e-bike (motor assist at minimum) — conditioning tailored to e-bike riding.
instructions: Ride at a steady 80-90 rpm cadence, motor on lowest assist level, for 40-60 min. Breath nasal-only if possible.

name: Cyclocross Dismount-Remount Drill
description: Repeated cyclocross-style running dismount and remount on flat ground — specific to the CX course skill set.
instructions: Ride slowly, unclip, swing leg over and land running, carry bike 10-15 m, remount on the fly. 6-10 reps.
progression: Add a shouldered bike carry over a small barrier.

name: Indoor-Cycling Standing Climb Interval
description: Standing out-of-saddle climb interval on an indoor trainer — replicates Zwift/Peloton-style climb work.
instructions: On a trainer with moderate resistance (70-80% FTP), ride out of the saddle at 60-70 rpm for 60-90 sec, seated recovery 90 sec. Repeat 4-6x.

name: Orienteering Compass-Run Drill
description: Short interval running at bearing-hold pace — sport-specific to map-running.
instructions: Set a visible marker 100-150 m away. Run at threshold-pace while keeping eye-line on the marker (not the ground). 6-8 reps, walking return.

name: Canicross Harness Lean-Pull Drill
description: Trunk-lean forward-pull drill simulating running while attached to a pulling dog.
instructions: Attach a band to a fixed anchor behind you at waist height. Run/jog forward against the resistance with hip-belt or canicross harness. 30-60s intervals.
cues: lean forward from the ankles, not waist

name: Fell-Running Steep Ascent Hike-Run
description: Alternating hike and run on steep gradient — fell-running and mountain-run specific.
instructions: On a 15-25% gradient, alternate 60s power-hike with 60s run-jog, for 10-20 min. Use poles if available.

name: Sprinting-Masters A-Skip
description: Low-intensity A-skip warm-up drill appropriate for masters sprinters — grooves the sprint pattern without max load.
instructions: Skip for 20 m with aggressive knee drive (knee to 90), foot dorsiflexed, tall posture. Walk back. 4-6 reps.
progression: Add B-skip and transition to accel.

name: Swimrun Wetsuit Transition Drill
description: Quick swim-to-run transition practice — specific to swimrun races where athletes keep wetsuit on.
instructions: Swim 25-50 m in shallow water, exit, immediately run 100 m, re-enter. 4-6 transitions.
progression: Longer swim legs or weighted vest run.

name: Aid-Climbing Top-Step Balance Iso
description: High-foot single-leg balance hold with one hand grip — direct aid-climbing top-step transfer.
instructions: Place one foot on a knee-height box. Rise fully, gripping a light overhead handle with one hand. Hold stacked tall for 15-30s per side.

name: Via Ferrata Arm-Over-Arm Cable Sim
description: Hand-over-hand rope/band climb simulation — specific to via-ferrata cable-handling endurance.
instructions: Anchor a thick rope or heavy band overhead at an angle. Climb hand-over-hand along it for 4-8 m, step back, repeat. 4-6 rounds.
home_variation: Thick rope or heavy band + anchor.

name: Alpine Kick-Step Traverse Sim
description: Side-step with weight shift on steep ground — replicates alpine kick-step traverse on snow/ice.
instructions: Find a 30-45 degree slope (or box at that angle). Take small kick-steps across the slope, engaging edge of foot. 10-15 steps per direction.
home_variation: Grassy slope or dense foam wedge.

name: Scrambling Three-Point Step-Down Drill
description: Slow, deliberate step-downs on rough terrain maintaining three points of contact — scrambling-specific skill.
instructions: On a short rocky step 1-2 ft high, face in, place hands, step down one foot at a time keeping two hands + one foot contact. 10-15 reps.

name: Canyoneering Stemming-Chimney Iso
description: Wall-to-wall stem position hold — bread and butter for canyon downclimbs.
instructions: Find two walls/boxes close enough to span. Stem with feet pressing opposite walls, hips up, hold 20-45s. Repeat 3-4x.

name: Ski-Touring Skin-Track Step
description: Uphill stride with heel-lift posture — specific to ski-touring skin-track cadence.
instructions: On a treadmill or hill at 10-15% grade, walk/stride with feet flat, torso slightly forward, 20-30 min.

name: Altitude CO2 Tolerance Breath-Hold
description: Breath-hold-on-exhale CO2 tolerance drill — safe dryland tool for altitude adaptation prep.
instructions: Seated calmly: exhale fully, hold 20-45s, inhale, breathe normally 60s. Repeat 5-8 cycles. Do not force hyperventilation. Stop if lightheaded.

name: Altitude Box-Step Hypoventilation Sim
description: Step-ups performed with nasal-only breathing and controlled exhale — aerobic-stress under breath restriction.
instructions: Step up and down on a knee-height box at 20-30 steps per minute. Breathe only through the nose with slow exhales. 8-12 min.

name: Snowshoe Deep-Snow Post-Hole Sim
description: High-knee stepping through resistance — simulates breaking trail in deep snow with snowshoes.
instructions: March in place with exaggerated knee-lift to hip height for 60-90s. Optionally step through resistance band wrapped around ankles.

name: Winter-Approach Pack-Carry Staircase
description: Loaded pack stair climb — approaches for winter and alpine objectives.
instructions: Wear a 15-30 lb pack. Climb a stair or steep slope for 8-15 min at steady effort. Poles optional.

name: XC Skiing Double-Pole Simulation
description: Dryland double-pole power drill — direct cross-country skiing specific.
instructions: Use cable or heavy band anchored high behind. Stand tall, drive both arms down-and-back to hip with simultaneous core flex. 10-15 reps.

name: Nordic Diagonal-Stride Bound
description: Running-bound drill with opposite arm-leg extension — classic nordic skiing specific.
instructions: Bound forward, pushing off one leg while driving opposite arm forward. Land on the other leg with contralateral arm back. 20-30 m.

name: Freestyle-Ski Landing Squat-Jump
description: Jump landing absorption drill — bread and butter for freestyle/park skiing and boardsports.
instructions: Jump off a box (12-18 in), land soft into a quarter squat and absorb, holding 1-2 sec. Step up and repeat. 5-8 reps.

name: Ski-Jumping In-Run Tuck Isometric
description: Deep tuck isometric hold — ski jumping and downhill in-run position.
instructions: Assume a deep-squat tuck with elbows outside the knees, chest over thighs, arms relaxed. Hold 20-45s. 3-4 sets.

name: Backcountry Avalanche-Probe Shovel Drill
description: Repeated shoveling motion from knees — direct transfer to avalanche rescue ability.
instructions: From kneeling, shovel snow (or sand) forward and to the side as fast as possible for 60-90s. Alternate sides.

name: Karate Kata Flow Drill
description: Slow-tempo kata-like movement chain — blends mobility and kinetic-chain coordination.
instructions: Chain 6-8 karate stances (zenkutsu, kokutsu, kiba-dachi) with transitions and blocks at slow tempo. 3-5 min continuous.

name: Krav-Maga 360-Defense Drill
description: Rapid arm-block drill against 360-degree attacks — central Krav Maga reactive pattern.
instructions: Partner or pad-holder simulates attacks from different angles (or set cones at 8 directions). Step off-line and block-strike to each direction. 30-60s rounds.

name: Sambo Belt-Grip Takedown Entry
description: Repeated belt-grip entry step — sambo-specific takedown setup drill.
instructions: Face partner or heavy bag. Step in with aggressive belt/hip grip, drop levels, drive forward 2-3 steps. Reset and repeat. 6-8 entries per side.
progression: Add takedown finish or weighted entry.

name: Aikido Tenkan Pivot Flow
description: Continuous pivot-turn flow — foundational aikido ukemi and blending footwork.
instructions: Stand in natural stance. Pivot 180 deg on the lead foot, step through, pivot again. Continuous smooth rotations for 2-3 min.
progression: Add partner redirect or pace variation.

name: Kung-Fu Horse-Stance Conditioning
description: Classic deep horse-stance hold — foundational kung fu lower-body conditioning.
instructions: Stand wide, thighs parallel to ground, back straight, hands at chamber. Hold 30-90s. 3-4 sets.

name: Capoeira Ginga Flow
description: Rhythmic ginga step — foundational capoeira rhythm-and-movement pattern.
instructions: Alternate back-step and side-step with arms rising in counter-rhythm. 2-3 min continuous at musical tempo.

name: HEMA Longsword Cut Pattern
description: Diagonal cutting pattern with a weighted stick or sword simulator — HEMA-specific.
instructions: Hold a weighted stick (3-5 lb) in both hands. Cut diagonal-down left, diagonal-down right, vertical. 8-12 reps per pattern.

name: Kendo Men-Strike Footwork Drill
description: Suri-ashi slide-step with overhead shinai strike — kendo-specific.
instructions: From shizen-tai, slide-step forward right foot, strike overhead with shinai, recover. 8-12 per side.

name: Iaido Nukitsuke Draw Isometric
description: Half-draw sword isometric hold — iaido-specific shoulder and grip control.
instructions: Assume iaido seiza or tachi-iai. Half-draw a light bokken/iaito, hold the position 20-45s. Focus on slow controlled tension.

name: Topgolf Club-Speed Swing Drill
description: Light-club overspeed swing — pure rotational speed training for casual golfers and Topgolf.
instructions: Use a 5-iron or lighter club. 10 swings per side at 90-95% effort, focused on smooth tempo. 2-3 sets.

name: Senior-Golf Half-Swing Mobility
description: Half-swing with emphasis on thoracic rotation — age-friendly golf swing builder.
